goal: Reliability, substantive current reporting and explainable adaptive spending. No percentage-savings objective.

financial_contract.base: The user-selected per-logical-run amount remains the ordinary allowance, not a spend requirement.
financial_contract.margin: RESEARCH_EVENT_MARGIN_FRACTION defaults to0.5 for event-adaptive producers; each logical run freezes its original base, margin and deadline.
financial_contract.event_admission: Only current evidence-backed investigations chosen by the existing LLM event nominator or a completed material-change assessment can authorize marginal research. Raw headline counts, price thresholds, cache expiry, retries and model errors cannot declare a heavy day.
financial_contract.quiet_days: Reuse completed dated company work before reserving optional full-model completion. The existing agent can choose fewer investigations. Current interpretation and final review continue.
financial_contract.marginal_math: Raise the ordinary working allowance only by the additional quoted funds needed for admitted event work. An atomic ledger includes active requests, unknown charges and future protected completion. Extensions are recorded against the selected event and never reset on retries.
financial_contract.ceiling: New discretionary research cannot exceed base times one plus marginal fraction. The pre-existing small completion-overrun allowance is separate and visible; it must not compound into another discretionary increase. Paid or mandatory completion obligations are never erased to make the ledger look within budget.
financial_contract.core: Current interpretation and final synthesis/review retain the configured full model. Stop optional expansion before sacrificing core work. A missing/zero allowance still yields a current economical report.
financial_contract.provider_contracts: Wire deployment names and pricing model identities are separate. Embeddings are input-only requests, including pre-tokenized batches. Unknown pricing remains a visible admission failure, never zero-cost inference.
financial_contract.controls: Model selection, margin, base and existing time/worker settings remain independently configurable. Budget changes do not grant more time or start more scheduled runs.
financial_contract.reporting: Attempts retain selected event identity. Final immutable producer receipts carry frozen base, current working allowance, event ceiling, event extension reasons, metered settled estimates, unknown reservations and protected completion.
financial_contract.capacity: Configured base event capacity scales by the frozen marginal fraction; this offers capacity to the nominator and never forces event count or spending. Completed history remains available after an empty quiet nomination.
financial_contract.company_freshness: An expired check interval triggers materiality/freshness assessment using current and original as-of times. A completed reuse decision advances only checked_at, never the original investigation date. Failed/uncertain assessment refreshes.

reliability.source_documents: Recognize binary formats before decoding. Use the same PDF extraction contract for uploaded and HTTP sources. Retain original response bytes and extraction provenance; unusable binary content is an explicit acquisition outcome, never pseudo-text.
reliability.opaque_checkpoints: Separate source bytes from model-readable text; verify no binary garbage enters the shared company checkpoint. Preserve complete paid output if the storage index is temporarily unavailable.
reliability.publication: Native immutable dataset manifests are publication authority. Reconstruct completed versions from immutable per-execution receipts when SQL retry metadata is absent. Persist publication progress using reserved metadata capacity, retain error causes and report degradation; do not republish or erase an existing dataset because a secondary sink failed.
reliability.learning: Retry saved reviews as independent durable work before buying new critiques. Preserve the completed critic when only verification is pending. Count deferred critiques and reviews from their actual admission decisions.
reliability.visibility: Accumulate recovered provider/source failures in the same logical producer receipt and Home operational health. Product prose remains substantive; diagnostics stay in operational records.
reliability.home_completion: Declare the full-model final Home synthesis/review obligation before optional discovery. Transfer that obligation into the actual final calls and release unused funding only after a valid result exists. This protects the logical run allowance; shared-account future obligations and unresolved transport liabilities remain a distinct open requirement.
reliability.provider_liquidity: A refreshed provider balance does not establish the actual cost or terminal state of an individual lost response. Keep unknown per-request costs visible. Current account-level admission starvation needs authoritative reconciliation or an explicit bounded-liability design before clearing holds; expiry alone is insufficient.

quality_investigation.confirmed: Current Home core writing and review use Pro. Existing budget admission blocks Azure semantic retrieval. Four optional company outputs used Flash at budget exhaustion.
quality_investigation.not_established: A blanket causal attribution of feed quality to cheaper summarization.
quality_investigation.review: Personally compare current full public fields with their full research inputs and retained paired outputs. Do not grade prose using phrase matching or reduce capability to fit a study allowance.
quality_investigation.source_fix: Each existing Home update acquires broad news. The existing shared event nominator performs bounded independent discovery and retains a substantive market synthesis even without focused event nominations. The final editor receives all acquired captures and that synthesis. Common research guidance uses numbers selectively rather than reciting the market table. Publication time, observation time and upcoming release status stay distinct; no topic/ticker-specific rules.
